messages.subject: Phylogenetic regression
parts:
Dear Geomorph Team, 

I am reaching out to seek your assistance with an issue I am encountering while attempting to perform a phylogenetic regression in R. When trying to execute the function "procD.pgls", I come across the following error: "Error in scaleCov(Cov, scale. = lambda) : could not find function 'scaleCov".

I have checked the documentation and searched online, but I have been unable to find a solution to this problem. It seems that the "scaleCov" function is not being recognized properly. I would like to request your help in understanding how I can resolve this issue.

Thank you in advance for your time and support in this matter. I look forward to your prompt response.

Best regards, Ana Sofía Duport Bru
